article.title: What does a top British artist earn?
article.excerpt: Last year the highest-earning British artist was Damien Hirst , the creator who cuts up dead sharks and puts them in formaldehyde. He pulled in twelve million British pounds last year (over twenty million dollars), although dealer’s commissions may have eaten into this figure.
